selection_reconstruction: Independent per-gene numpy variance over training donor effects; exclude own perturbation; control CPM >=1 from training donor only; Python stable sort by descending variance and gene name
mask_verification: Both true and mismatched target removed for every arm
leakage_review: No held-out outcome values enter selection or predictions. Gene/target identities and common coverage are shared design information. This is reused-data development sensitivity, not untouched confirmation. Source inclusion and target availability can still limit generalization.
